acceptance_criteria: smime_policy returns without panic. Listed tests pass.
close_reason: smime_policy implemented: 1185-day cap, SHA-1 excluded, min 2048-bit RSA, require SAN, require emailProtection EKU. Tests pass.
description:
Implement smime_policy(now_unix) in pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs to return a ValidationPolicy enforcing CA/B Forum S/MIME Baseline Requirements (current version: v1.0+).

The S/MIME BR defines four mailbox types (Mailbox-validated, Organization-validated, Sponsor-validated, Individual-validated) and three key usage profiles (legacy, multipurpose, strict). This implementation targets the common Mailbox-validated / strict profile as the baseline.

Constraints to set:
- max_validity_secs: 1185 * 86400  (1185 days / ~39 months, per S/MIME BR §6.3.2 for strict profile)
- allowed_signature_algs: same SHA-1 exclusion as web_pki_policy. SHA-256/384/512 RSA and ECDSA allowed.
- min_rsa_key_bits: 2048  (S/MIME BR §6.1.5)
- require_subject_alt_name: true  (rfc822Name SAN required for Mailbox-validated)
- required_leaf_eku: [id-kp-emailProtection]  (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.4)

Remove the unimplemented!() panic. Update rustdoc to list enforced constraints and note that only the Mailbox-validated/strict profile is implemented; other types (OV, SV, IV) are v0.3 scope.

Tests:
- A cert with id-kp-emailProtection EKU and rfc822Name SAN passes
- A cert missing id-kp-emailProtection is rejected
- A cert exceeding 1185-day validity is rejected
- SHA-1 cert rejected
title: Implement smime_policy (CA/B Forum S/MIME BR)
